WAI1 UTF8 LF; record=(2 spaces)^depth opcode fields; final LF. Literal kN:data; k i/p/h/c/n/d/u/q/t means identifier/path/sha256/command/number/date/link/quotation/text; N decoded UTF8 bytes; escapes \\ \s \: \t \n \r \xHH. Fields(opcode,depth): D,0,id,title; S,1,id,path,sha256; H,1,id,title; R/F/P/X/Y/U,2,id,statement = require/forbid/permit/refuse/recover/unknown; W/N,d,predicate = when/unless; C,d,scope; E,d,target,predicate; children d+1. M,3,id,claim; depth 4 order V+ evidence,K+ evidence_class,G boundary,A+ authorises,Q 0..3,J+ refuses,Z+ recovery,I* id,authority,gate,subject,scope,record,expiry,recovery. </>/^,1,source,target = before/after/overrides. B,1,source,node,start,end,reviewer; start/end are bare canonical decimals. Order D,S*,H*(directives(expressions,M?)),relations*,B*. JSON=(schema document sources sections relations bindings); literal=(kind value); directive=(id kind statement expressions promise).
